s1.syndrome_frame: inflammatory arthritis and skin lesions with systemic symptoms
key_facts: man in his 50s
dermal papules on trunk and extremities
preference for extensor surfaces of arms and legs
no lymphadenopathy
relief of symptoms with daily oral prednisone
flare of symptoms with taper below 10 mg
previous treatments included hydroxychloroquine and adalimumab without improvement
mild restrictive disease on pulmonary function tests
skin biopsy showed nodular to diffuse lymphohistiocytic infiltrate
atypical lymphocytes with numerous histiocytes on skin biopsy
low CD4 signal and robust CD8 signal on immunostaining
clonal rearrangements identified in skin biopsy specimens and bone marrow sample

raw.syndrome_frame: inflammatory arthritis and skin lesions with systemic symptoms
key_facts: man in his 50s
dermal papules on trunk and extremities
preference for extensor surfaces of arms and legs
no lymphadenopathy
relief of symptoms with daily oral prednisone
flare of symptoms with taper below 10 mg
previous treatments included hydroxychloroquine and adalimumab without improvement
mild restrictive disease on pulmonary function tests
skin biopsy showed nodular to diffuse lymphohistiocytic infiltrate
atypical lymphocytes with numerous histiocytes on skin biopsy
low CD4 signal and robust CD8 signal on immunostaining
clonal rearrangements identified in skin biopsy specimens and bone marrow sample

differentials: Interstitial lung disease associated with rheumatoid arthritis
per_call: Interstitial lung disease associated with rheumatoid arthritis

shortlist.label: Cutaneous T-cell lymphoma
shortlist.why_kept: skin biopsy showed nodular to diffuse lymphohistiocytic infiltrate and atypical lymphocytes with numerous histiocytes, and clonal rearrangements identified in skin biopsy specimens and bone marrow sample

shortlist.label: Lymphomatoid papulosis
shortlist.why_kept: presence of pink-purple dermal papules and lymphohistiocytic infiltrate on skin biopsy, and relief of symptoms with daily oral prednisone

shortlist.label: Mycosis fungoides
shortlist.why_kept: skin biopsy findings and presence of atypical lymphocytes with low CD4 signal and robust CD8 signal on immunostaining

shortlist.label: Sézary syndrome
shortlist.why_kept: systemic symptoms such as fatigue, dyspnea on exertion, and weight loss, and presence of atypical lymphocytes with inverted CD8:CD4 ratio on immunostaining

shortlist.label: Dermatomyositis
shortlist.why_kept: presence of dermal papules on extensor surfaces of arms and legs, and relief of symptoms with daily oral prednisone

raw.rationale: The presence of pink-purple dermal papules, particularly on the extensor surfaces of the arms and legs, along with the skin biopsy findings of nodular to diffuse lymphohistiocytic infiltrate and atypical lymphocytes, are characteristic of mycosis fungoides. Additionally, the clonal rearrangements identified in skin biopsy specimens and bone marrow sample support this diagnosis.

rejected.label: Cutaneous T-cell lymphoma
rejected.why: Too broad, mycosis fungoides is a specific type of cutaneous T-cell lymphoma

rejected.label: Lymphomatoid papulosis
rejected.why: Typically presents with more transient and self-healing lesions, not consistent with the patient's chronic symptoms

rejected.label: Sézary syndrome
rejected.why: Characterized by erythroderma, lymphadenopathy, and atypical lymphocytes in the blood, which are not present in this case

rejected.label: Dermatomyositis
rejected.why: Typically presents with muscle weakness, Gottron's papules, and a distinct set of laboratory abnormalities, which are not consistent with this patient's presentation
